fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: always 0 in every save image seen; the format routine starts writing at 0x10

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Text FF1_SAVE_VER_008; checked at power-on, the whole save area is wiped and re-formatted if it does not match
fields.evidence: save code writes it when formatting and compares it at boot (reader at f000:128a); appears when a blank card is first powered on

fields.name: cart_id
fields.meaning: Text FF1DG-SRAM_ID/01; second power-on check, same handling as the signature
fields.evidence: same format/boot code as the signature (reader at f000:12b9)

fields.name: slots
fields.meaning: Eight save slots of 0x300 bytes, slot n (n=1..8) at 0x0030 + (n-1)*0x300. Rows below give the layout using slot 1; the same layout applies to every slot
fields.evidence: slot save code (slot*0x300+0x30) and slot check; two natural saves occupy slots 1 and 2

fields.name: slot_magic
fields.meaning: Text F1 marks a used slot; 00 00 shows as EMPTY in the load list
fields.evidence: writer stores F1, checker compares 2 bytes (reader at f000:1318); empty slots are zero

fields.name: map_pos_a
fields.meaning: Position on the world map (x, y): 0x92,0x99 where a new game starts, 0x91,0x9c in the Cornelia save
fields.evidence: new-game setup values vs the natural save; read by map code; changeable by script code

fields.name: map_id
fields.meaning: Current map number: 0 where a new game starts, 0x3b in the Cornelia town save
fields.evidence: read as the map number by about ten places in the map code; fed to the place-name display together with the in-map position

fields.name: unknown_603
fields.meaning: Unknown (0)
fields.evidence: cleared at new game; reachable from script code

fields.name: map_pos_b
fields.meaning: Position inside the current map (x, y): 0x0c,0x09 in the Cornelia save
fields.evidence: the step handler reads and writes these bytes with bounds checks, and the place-name display reads them

fields.name: unknown_606
fields.meaning: Unknown (0)
fields.evidence: cleared at new game

fields.name: vehicle_pos
fields.meaning: Two more coordinate pairs (0xcb,0x92 and 0xd6,0xe6), unchanged since new game; probably ship and airship positions
fields.evidence: new-game values; unchanged in the natural save

fields.name: place_selector_60b
fields.meaning: Unknown value (0) that is read together with the map number and position to pick the displayed place name
fields.evidence: place-name display routine reads it; exact meaning not known

fields.name: chest_flags
fields.meaning: 256 opened-treasure-chest flags, one bit per chest (chest k = byte k/8, bit k%8)
fields.evidence: a flag is tested by matching map-object coordinates and set right before the item is handed out; all 0 in the early save

fields.name: event_flags
fields.meaning: 256 story/event flags, one bit each (flag k = byte k/8, bit k%8); flag 199 is set in the natural save
fields.evidence: flag test/set routines fully decoded; a shop sets a flag after a purchase; single flag meanings mostly unknown

fields.name: settings
fields.meaning: Settings bytes: first byte bit flags (0xa7 at new game), then 03 02 00 07 01, rest 0
fields.evidence: new-game values; bit 0 set by the start-up defaults, bit 3 tested by many menu and battle routines

fields.name: unknown_65c
fields.meaning: Unknown (0)
fields.evidence: zero in every save seen

fields.name: text_colour
fields.meaning: Text colour word 0x0fff (white, 4 bits per red/green/blue)
fields.evidence: colour-reset routine stores 0xfff here

fields.name: unknown_660
fields.meaning: A setting byte set to 0 at new game and read by the screen code
fields.evidence: new-game write; screen-code readers

fields.name: window_palette
fields.meaning: Eight window colours, 4 bits per red/green/blue, copied from the built-in default at new game (0000 0332 0666 0888 0aaa 0eee 0349 0339)
fields.evidence: colour-reset routine copies the default table; values match in the save

fields.name: key_items
fields.meaning: Key items: 32 bytes, each holds the id of a key item (ids below 0x20) the party owns, 0 = free
fields.evidence: add/remove item routines; empty in the early save

fields.name: inventory
fields.meaning: Item bag: 86 pairs of (item id, count); ids 0x20 and up; count capped at 99; id 0 = free
fields.evidence: add/remove routines with the 99 cap in code; empty in the early save

fields.name: gil
fields.meaning: Gil (money): 370 in the natural save (400 at new game minus the 30 gil inn fee)
fields.evidence: new game stores 400; the save screen shows the value; add/subtract routines cap at 999999

fields.name: steps
fields.meaning: Steps walked: 53 in the natural save, shown with a ポ suffix
fields.evidence: The step routine increments the 32-bit working counter with byte and word carries; prepared-counter tests observed 0xFFFFFFFF wrapping to zero. Prepared values 0, 255, 256, 65535, and 65536 were stored with valid slot checksums and restored to RAM at frame 1500 after a fresh-power load on the tested route. Prepared value 655,359,999 was saved with a valid slot checksum and restored to RAM at frame 1500 on the tested fresh-power route. Values 655,360,000 and 655,360,001 were each serialized exactly with valid slot checksums, but neither was restored to RAM by that tested cold-load route at frame 1500; the cause is unknown. Values 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, and 0xFFFFFFFF were stored exactly with valid slot checksums, but were not restored to RAM by that tested cold-load route at frame 1500; the cause is unknown. Natural reachability, behavior on other load paths, and a maximum safe value remain unverified.

fields.name: time_hours
fields.meaning: Play time hours (0-99)
fields.evidence: play-time tick routine

fields.name: time_minutes
fields.meaning: Play time minutes (0-59); 2 in the natural save, shown as 00:02
fields.evidence: tick routine; on-screen clock; two saves minutes apart differ here

fields.name: time_seconds
fields.meaning: Play time seconds (0-59)
fields.evidence: tick routine; two saves 590 frames apart went 5 s 30 f -> 13 s 20 f

fields.name: time_frames
fields.meaning: Play time fraction of a second, in 1/75 s steps (0-74)
fields.evidence: tick routine wraps at 75; same two-save diff

fields.name: vehicle_cache_749
fields.meaning: Bit flags caching 4 story flags for the world-map vehicles (flag 0x13 -> bit 0, 0x11 -> bit 1, 0x22 -> bit 2, 0x1d -> bit 3); 0 in the save
fields.evidence: rebuilt from the story flags whenever the world map is drawn; which vehicle each bit means is unknown

fields.name: unknown_74a
fields.meaning: Unknown (0)
fields.evidence: zero in every save seen

fields.name: table_74b
fields.meaning: 16-byte table copied as a whole to and from a work area; at new game bytes 2, 5 and 8 are 2, 4, 6
fields.evidence: new-game values; whole-table copy routines

fields.name: characters
fields.meaning: Four party members, 0x58 bytes each, member k (k=1..4) at slot+0x15d + (k-1)*0x58. Rows below use member 1
fields.evidence: 0x58 stride used by the list drawing and many routines; start-up data holds 4 default records

fields.name: char_class
fields.meaning: Job: 0 = fighter, 1 = thief in the natural save (two green thieves and two red fighters on screen)
fields.evidence: screen colours; stats match the job base values; the slot list reads it to draw each sprite

fields.name: char_status
fields.meaning: Status condition bits (0 = healthy)
fields.evidence: code tests bit 2 of this word

fields.name: char_level
fields.meaning: Level (1 for all four)
fields.evidence: matches LV 1 on screen

fields.name: char_exp
fields.meaning: Probably experience points (0 at the start)
fields.evidence: zero in every record seen

fields.name: char_hp
fields.meaning: Current HP (30 / 30 / 35 / 35)
fields.evidence: on-screen HP; battle code decrements this word

fields.name: char_max_hp
fields.meaning: Maximum HP
fields.evidence: equals HP at full health on screen

fields.name: char_stats
fields.meaning: Strength, agility, intelligence, vitality, luck (thief 5,10,5,5,15; fighter 20,5,1,10,5 = the classic job start values)
fields.evidence: values match the job base stats

fields.name: char_combat
fields.meaning: Attack, hit rate, defence, evasion, magic defence (thief 2,5,0,58,15; fighter 10,10,0,53,15 = values derived from the stats)
fields.evidence: values match the derived values; ends where the name starts

fields.name: char_name
fields.meaning: Name, 4 characters in the game text code (0x00 = あ, 0xfb = blank): member 1 is ああああ, members 2-4 are あ
fields.evidence: bytes match the names on screen for all four members; built-in defaults use 00/01/02/03

fields.name: char_name_end
fields.meaning: 0xff end mark after the name
fields.evidence: present in all 4 natural and 4 built-in records

fields.name: char_byte_1b
fields.meaning: 0x02 for mage jobs in the built-in records, 0 otherwise; possibly starting magic
fields.evidence: differs by job in the built-in data; 0 in the natural save

fields.name: char_bytes_1c_22
fields.meaning: Unknown (all 0)
fields.evidence: zero in every record seen

fields.name: char_byte_23
fields.meaning: 0x02 for mage jobs in the built-in records, 0 otherwise; possibly starting magic
fields.evidence: differs by job in the built-in data; 0 in the natural save

fields.name: char_bytes_24_47
fields.meaning: Unknown (all 0 at LV1 with no equipment or magic; probably equipment, spells and MP)
fields.evidence: zero in every record seen

fields.name: char_ff_block
fields.meaning: 16 bytes all 0xff for every member (probably empty-entry marks for a list such as magic)
fields.evidence: identical in all records seen

fields.name: char4_last_byte
fields.meaning: Would hold the last byte of member 4 but is never saved: the copy length is rounded down to whole words, so it stays 0 here while members 1-3 have 0xff at the same place
fields.evidence: save code copies 0x2bb bytes as 0x15d words; 0x02ec = 0 vs 0xff in members 1-3

fields.name: slot_padding
fields.meaning: Rest of the slot; zero-filled before every save
fields.evidence: clear routine zeroes the slot, then copies the game state over it

fields.name: slots_2_8
fields.meaning: Slots 2 to 8, same layout as slot 1, slot n at 0x0030 + (n-1)*0x300
fields.evidence: slot code; a second natural save in slot 2 matches slot 1 apart from the play time

fields.name: suspend_record
fields.meaning: Separate one-shot record: F1 + a longer game-state copy, erased after it is loaded. Empty in all natural saves seen
fields.evidence: write/check/load/erase routines decoded; never observed holding data

fields.name: header_check
fields.meaning: 16-bit word sum of 0x0020-0x1baf, written only when the save area is formatted (so it always equals the sum of the id text, 0x0125); nothing checks it
fields.evidence: format code computes it; a whole-ROM search finds no caller of the check routine

fields.name: slot_checks
fields.meaning: Slot checksums, one 16-bit word per slot (slot n at 0x1bb2 + (n-1)*2): word sum of the slot's 0x300 bytes including the F1 mark
fields.evidence: sum/store/check routines; recomputed and matched on every used slot in 301 save images

fields.name: suspend_check
fields.meaning: Checksum of the suspend record: word sum of 0x1830-0x1baf
fields.evidence: same word-sum routine; 0 = sum of the empty record

fields.name: unknown_1bc4
fields.meaning: Unknown (0)
fields.evidence: zero in every save image; no writer found

fields.name: last_slot
fields.meaning: Slot number (0-7) of the last save; the save and load lists open with the cursor on it
fields.evidence: stored after every save; read to place the list cursor; differs between the two natural saves

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in every save image; no writer found

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The internal EEPROM is not used for saves
fields.evidence: identical across all states including the natural saves

values.value: written at format time only; never checked by the game
